companies.name: Core Development Group
companies.quote: Under the banner of his real estate development companies, Core Development Group and The Guberman Group, Guberman has crafted over twenty boutique buildings, multiple restaurants, commercial and hospitality projects, as well as several ground up condominiums, providing the highest level of service and quality with every undertaking.
